title: EzRestero — Smart Restaurant & Order Management System
summary: Next-gen POS, QR menu ordering, and kitchen workflow platform for modern restaurants and dining chains.
challenge: Traditional POS systems suffered from slow order routing, kitchen delays, and poor table QR ordering experiences.
solution: Engineered a real-time order sync portal with sub-50ms table checkout and automated kitchen display routing.

title: MSG — Unified Messaging & Client Communication Platform
summary: High-speed unified inbox and broadcast engine connecting WhatsApp, SMS, and email for instant customer support.
challenge: Fragmented customer chats led to dropped leads and slow response times across multiple channels.
solution: Unified all inbound communication into a single realtime dashboard powered by Next.js and socket gateways.

title: Dropizi Courier — Dynamic Logistics & Parcel Delivery Engine
summary: Upcoming end-to-end courier dispatching platform, dynamic parcel route optimization, and live GPS delivery tracking.
challenge: Manual courier assignment and legacy tracking systems caused delay bottlenecks across last-mile delivery.
solution: Developing autonomous parcel assignment algorithms, driver mobile dispatch portals, and live SMS/WhatsApp delivery alerts.
